g
Persistent data clean-up after Software Cluster re-
moval
⌈
UCM
shall remove persistent data of a removed
SoftwareCluster
by ag-
gregating the information given in the application manifest, namely PersistencyKeyVal-
ueStorage.uri and PersistencyFileStorage.uri, in order to leave the
AUTOSAR Adap-
tive Platform
and the file system clean.
⌋
(RS_UCM_00026, RS_UCM_00017,
RS_UCM_00004)
For more details, please refer to [SWS_PER_00397] in Persistency Specification [11].
